subject: literacy
concept: Organizing notes from multiple sources into categories before writing
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student physically sorts note cards from several sources into labeled category piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches scattered notes to the correct category heading
exercise.abstract: Student organizes a set of collected notes into 2-3 clear categories before writing

misconception_flags: places notes into categories inconsistently or without a clear organizing logic

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
